groups.title: Construction
groups.intro: Every project starts with a free on-site consultation. You get a design and a detailed written quote before any work begins, then our crew builds it.

items.title: Outdoor backyard design
items.text: We plan your backyard around how you want to use it and show you a 3D design and a written quote before anything is built.
items.alt: 3D design of a raised paver patio with steps

items.title: Pavers
items.text: Paver patios, walkways and driveways laid on a properly prepared base.
items.alt: Side-yard paver patio with a granite border

items.title: Retaining walls
items.text: Walls that level a sloping yard, create usable space and add structure.
items.alt: Paver patio under a covered porch beside a block retaining wall

items.title: Decks
items.text: Decks that extend your living space outdoors, built to suit your yard and your home.
items.alt: Composite deck platform and pavers in a fenced backyard

items.title: Masonry work
items.text: Stone and block work, including steps, pillars and walls.
items.alt: Finished stone front entry steps and walkway

items.title: Concrete
items.text: Concrete patios, walkways, pads and steps.

items.title: Outdoor kitchens
items.text: Built-in grill stations and outdoor kitchens for cooking and entertaining outside.

items.title: Stone veneer
items.text: Stone facing for walls, steps, pillars and outdoor kitchens.

groups.title: Lawn maintenance
groups.heading: Keep your lawn and yard looking cared for
groups.intro: Regular lawn care and clean-ups for yards we've built and yards we haven't.
groups.alt: Well-kept front lawn with a mature tree and mulched beds

items.title: Lawn mowing
items.text: Regular mowing to keep your lawn neat and even.

items.title: Fertilization
items.text: Feeding your lawn at the right times of year for strong, green growth.

items.title: Aeration
items.text: Loosening compacted soil so water, air and nutrients reach the roots.

items.title: Property cleanup
items.text: Clearing leaves, debris and overgrowth to get your yard back in shape.

items.text: Garden beds, shrubs and trees chosen for your site and the amount of upkeep you want.
